Twenty-second Chapter
</margin>

Furthermore, in the same way, one accomplishes one's own body through a body that is not the same; accomplishes the bodies of others through the bodies of others; accomplishes one's own body through the bodies of others; accomplishes the bodies of others through one's own body; accomplishes one's own body through non-body; accomplishes non-body through the body; accomplishes one's own body by not accomplishing the body; accomplishes one's own body by not accomplishing one's own body; accomplishes by not accomplishing one's own body, by not accomplishing one's own body; accomplishes by not accomplishing one's own body, by not accomplishing one's own body, by not accomplishing; <summary>This page contains a repetitive tantric formula from the Twenty-second Chapter regarding the non-dual nature of the body and the process of accomplishment. It uses a recursive linguistic structure to exhaust the conceptual possibilities of creating or realizing the self and others through various states of being and non-being.</summary>
